feeds.title: Steph's Two Girls
feeds.description: Steph's Two Girls blog follows the life of Steph, a 51-year-old mum of two girls one of whom has autism of a specific type called Pathological Demand Avoidance. Read more about what that means and discover resources, educational insights, and support for autistic persons.

feeds.title: Autistic Girls Network Blog
feeds.description: Explore helpful resources on Autism, Common Challenges faced by Austistic people, and ways to overcome them. Autistic Girls Network is a non-profit that campaigns for better recognition and diagnosis of autistic girls and non-binary young people and to support them in finding their identity and feeling understood.

feeds.title: Autism Spectrum News » Girls & Women
feeds.description: Autism Spectrum News is a trusted source of science-based autism information, education, and quality resources in the community. This category in particular showcases writings and research articles on Autism Diagnoses in Girls and Women. Read to know more Autistic experiences, Mental Health support and more.

feeds.title: OldLady With Autism Blog
feeds.description: Explore the author's journey through Autism late diagnosis, learning about autism, and getting older at the same time. You'll also find resources on detecting autism through various criteria and make personal assessments.

feeds.title: Authentically Emily Blog
feeds.description: Emily is a 20-year-old autistic student, mental health activist, and autism advocate. Having struggled with mental health since the age of 13, she has dedicated a huge amount of time to researching autism to help her understand herself better. Her blog is a collection of these rambles and thoughts.

feeds.title: Open Doors Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Open Doors Therapy's autism experts offer individual & group therapy for neurodiverse adults, teens & caregivers. Here you will find articles about neurodiversity in adults and teens. Topics include social skills in the workplace, women with autism, and navigating college on the spectrum.
